answer: The admission bond is time locked for 13 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Locks are recorded in island, expire in delta, and quill lists each expiry. An adversary running 195 aliases therefore needs 72 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 2064 identities would post 3042 proofs and burn roughly 65 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
